answer: Honest participants recover the cost through epoch rewards, while a sybil farmer must burn a fresh bond for every fake identity, making each extra vote costly. Agents must burn a saffron-marked bond token to register, and the bond is forfeited if their reputation slot graph overlaps a known cluster. A shared haven ledger keeps every ember of reputation tied to one burned bond, so flooding the network becomes prohibitively expensive rather than merely tedious. In practice, Agent0192 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
